template_data.headline_html: Five checks before you bid anything.

items.title: Basis of Award alignment
items.sub: GSA price must stay at or below your best commercial rate

items.title: Price Reduction Clause
items.sub: Post-award commercial discounts trigger retroactive GSA adjustments

items.title: Pricelist date
items.sub: Stale pricelists flag noncompliance before COs read your name

items.title: Unlisted service lines
items.sub: New offerings need a modification before you can legally bid them

items.title: EPA clause window
items.sub: Miss the deadline and your rates lock longer than you planned
